n01733.head: NRF2 transcriptional program
n01733.name: NRF2 transcriptional program (target genes, NRF2 expression, GSK3B-BTRC degradation)
n01733.rationale: Every member is NRF2 (NFE2L2) target-gene regulation or control of NRF2 itself, which separates it from the FOXO/UPR, ROS-detoxification and p53-metabolic neighbours.

n01628.head: Myeloid progenitor commitment to granulocytes
n01628.name: Myeloid progenitor commitment to granulocytes (transcriptional control, promyelocytes, monocyte-macrophage suppression)
n01628.rationale: Members describe progenitor proliferation, transcriptional granulopoiesis and repression of monocyte/macrophage fate, unlike the erythroid-megakaryocyte, monocyte and G-CSF/eosinophil neighbours.

n03614.head: Respiratory system development
n03614.name: Respiratory system development (lung branching and growth, pneumocyte differentiation, trachea and diaphragm)
n03614.rationale: Members build the lung, trachea and diaphragm; pneumocytes, trachea and diaphragm separate it from the surfactant and generic salivary-branching neighbours.

n03950.head: Gluconeogenic amino acid and choline-carnitine metabolism
n03950.name: Gluconeogenic amino acid and choline-carnitine metabolism (alanine, threonine, oxaloacetate)
n03950.rationale: Two unrelated strands (alanine/threonine feeding gluconeogenesis via oxaloacetate, and choline/carnitine metabolism) with no honest single idea; the pairing distinguishes it from the acyl-CoA, broad amino acid, TCA and biotin/carnitine-transport neighbours.

n00085.head: FGF receptor signaling
n00085.name: FGF receptor signaling (isoform-specific ligand binding, FRS/PLC/PI3K cascades, oncogenic mutants)
n00085.rationale: Nearly all members are FGFR1-4 ligand binding, downstream adaptor cascades or activating FGFR mutations, separating it from the broad RTK/RAS, ALK/PDGFR and drug-resistance neighbours.

n00330.head: Inherited glycogen synthesis defects
n00330.name: Inherited glycogen synthesis defects (glycogen synthase, glycogenin, branching enzyme)
n00330.rationale: All four are glycogen storage diseases of the synthesis enzymes, unlike neighbours centred on glycogen breakdown, glucose-6-phosphatase and glucokinase.

n00244.head: Endosomal TLR7/8/9 signaling regulation
n00244.name: Endosomal TLR7/8/9 signaling regulation (SLC15A4-TASL-IRF5 axis, self-ligand sensing)
n00244.rationale: Members regulate endosomal nucleic-acid TLRs, including IRF5 activation and defective TLR7 control by self ligands, rather than the cytosolic sensor or type I IFN output emphasised by neighbours.

n01593.head: Glutathione degradation and gamma-glutamyl cycle
n01593.name: Glutathione degradation and gamma-glutamyl cycle (GGT1/OPLAH/ACY1 defects, glutathione and cystine transport)
n01593.rationale: Members cover breakdown and transport of glutathione and its inborn errors, distinct from the glutathione synthesis and cystinuria/SLC transport neighbours.

n04313.head: Craniofacial development
n04313.name: Craniofacial development (olfactory system, trigeminal/facial nerves, lacrimal and salivary glands)
n04313.rationale: Members build nose, olfactory nerve and GnRH-neuron route, cranial nerves, taste papillae and head glands; olfactory and gland parts separate it from the ear and hindbrain neighbours.

n03469.head: Excitatory and inhibitory postsynapse assembly
n03469.name: Excitatory and inhibitory postsynapse assembly (neurexin-neuroligin, receptor clustering, glutamatergic transmission)
n03469.rationale: Members assemble glutamatergic and GABAergic postsynaptic sites and tune their potentials; glutamatergic transmission and inhibitory synapse parts separate it from the adhesion-focused neighbours.

n03247.head: Embryonic eye development
n03247.name: Embryonic eye development (optic cup and retina, retinal neuron differentiation, optic nerve)
n03247.rationale: Members form the optic cup, retinal layers and neurons, iris, eyelid and optic nerve, unlike neighbours on lens/cornea, retinal vasculature and phototransduction.

n03222.head: ER tubular network shaping
n03222.name: ER tubular network shaping (membrane bending, ER fusion, contact-site lipid transfer)
n03222.rationale: Members shape, fuse and position the ER tubular network and move lipids at its contacts, unlike the mitochondrial-contact and phosphoinositide neighbours.

n01911.head: Mitotic spindle assembly
n01911.name: Mitotic spindle assembly (centrosome separation, PLK1, NEK6/7/9 kinases)
n01911.rationale: Members drive centrosome separation and spindle formation via PLK1 and NEK kinases, unlike neighbours on the spindle checkpoint, midzone and Aurora A.

n04087.head: Eicosanoid synthesis and signaling
n04087.name: Eicosanoid synthesis and signaling (cyclooxygenase prostanoids, P450 HETEs and EETs, prostanoid receptors)
n04087.rationale: Members make arachidonate-derived eicosanoids by cyclooxygenase and P450 and act through prostanoid receptors, unlike the lipoxygenase, resolvin and leukotriene neighbours.

n00475.head: Collagen degradation
n00475.name: Collagen degradation (matrix metalloproteinase activation)
n00475.rationale: All three members concern collagen breakdown by activated MMPs, unlike the ECM-structure and fibrinolysis neighbours.

n01922.head: Neuropeptide GPCR signaling
n01922.name: Neuropeptide GPCR signaling (orexin wakefulness, opioid receptors, dense-core vesicle release)
n01922.rationale: Members are neuropeptide release and G-protein signaling including orexin-driven wakefulness, unlike neighbours on drug reward, sleep stages and stress behaviour.

n04531.head: Recombination-based telomere maintenance
n04531.name: Recombination-based telomere maintenance (break-induced replication, D-loop and t-circle control, telomere capping)
n04531.rationale: Members maintain and protect telomeres by recombination and break-induced replication, unlike neighbours on general DNA repair, telomere packaging and C-strand synthesis.

n01477.head: Interferon-stimulated host control of viral replication
n01477.name: Interferon-stimulated host control of viral replication (ISG15 conjugation, viral entry and release)
n01477.rationale: Members are ISG15 and other interferon-stimulated effects on viral entry, replication and release, unlike the OAS/PKR/IFN-signaling and generic viral life-cycle neighbours.

n00502.head: GPCR control of growth hormone release
n00502.name: GPCR control of growth hormone release (glucagon-family receptors, somatostatin receptors, adenylate cyclase)
n00502.rationale: Glucagon-family (GHRH) and somatostatin receptors steer cAMP and growth hormone secretion, unlike the GH-receptor, glucagon-metabolic and insulin-secretion neighbours.

n02226.head: Polyunsaturated fatty acid oxygenation
n02226.name: Polyunsaturated fatty acid oxygenation (lipoxygenase products, P450 HETEs and EETs, ichthyosis defects)
n02226.rationale: Members oxygenate arachidonate and linoleate by lipoxygenases and P450s, including skin-barrier ichthyosis genes, unlike the leukotriene-receptor, resolvin and cyclooxygenase neighbours.

n00547.head: Cochlear hair cell mechanotransduction
n00547.name: Cochlear hair cell mechanotransduction (stereocilia organization, inner hair cell sound processing)
n00547.rationale: All members concern sound detection by cochlear hair-cell stereocilia, unlike the vestibular, ear-morphogenesis and photoreceptor neighbours.

n02883.head: Immunoregulatory cytokine signaling
n02883.name: Immunoregulatory cytokine signaling (IL-12/23 and IL-10, IL-15 and IL-21, NK cell development)
n02883.rationale: Members are cytokines that steer lymphocyte and NK responses; IL-10/12/23 separate it from the interferon and IL-2/7 neighbours and IL-15/21 with NK development from the IL-27/35 neighbour.

n01952.head: Promotion of structural synaptic plasticity
n01952.name: Promotion of structural synaptic plasticity (dendritic spine morphogenesis, synapse maturation, local translation)
n01952.rationale: Members promote spine growth, synapse maturation and synaptic translation, unlike the CREB/memory, postsynaptic-actin and LTP/LTD neighbours.

n02217.head: Potentiation of synaptic transmission
n02217.name: Potentiation of synaptic transmission (glutamatergic and GABAergic, NCAM1 interactions, sensorimotor gating)
n02217.rationale: Members enhance glutamatergic and GABAergic transmission with prepulse inhibition and nonassociative learning, unlike the exploratory-behaviour, synapse-assembly and AMPA-receptor neighbours.

n03207.head: Protein glycan biosynthesis
n03207.name: Protein glycan biosynthesis (N- and O-glycans, glycosaminoglycan chains, fucosylated blood-group antigens)
n03207.rationale: Members build glycans on proteins and proteoglycans and their inherited defects, unlike the nucleotide-sugar transport and glycosphingolipid neighbours.

n01446.head: Neutrophil granulopoiesis
n01446.name: Neutrophil granulopoiesis (G-CSF/GM-CSF signaling, transcriptional control, negative regulation)
n01446.rationale: All members drive or restrain neutrophil production from myeloid progenitors; the CSF signaling and negative-regulation members separate it from progenitor, monocyte-macrophage and eosinophil/mast cell themes.

n00192.head: Global-genome excision repair of UV damage
n00192.name: Global-genome excision repair of UV damage (lesion recognition, dual incision)
n00192.rationale: Members cover UV pyrimidine dimer recognition and incision by global-genome NER, distinct from gap-filling/translesion synthesis themes and from transcription-coupled NER.

n00372.head: Beta-catenin-TCF transcription and its repression
n00372.name: Beta-catenin-TCF transcription and its repression (AXIN/APC mutants, RUNX3)
n00372.rationale: Members concern the nuclear beta-catenin-TCF output of canonical Wnt and its negative control, unlike confusables centred on receptor, DVL and ligand-level Wnt events.

n00012.head: Pentose metabolism
n00012.name: Pentose metabolism (non-oxidative pentose phosphate branch, glucuronate-xylulose pathway, xylulose 5-phosphate)
n00012.rationale: Members interconvert pentose phosphates via the non-oxidative shunt and the glucuronate-xylulose route, separating them from fructose, polyol and galactose themes.

n04415.head: Receptor tyrosine kinase-driven AKT/ERK activation
n04415.name: Receptor tyrosine kinase-driven AKT/ERK activation (oncogenic fusions and amplifications, FGFR/PDGFR/ALK/LTK)
n04415.rationale: Members are RTKs, mostly oncogenic fusion and amplification variants, signaling to PI3K-AKT and ERK, distinct from normal ERBB/MET/FGFR cascades and TKI-resistance mutant themes.

n03609.head: Apical membrane trafficking in ductal epithelia
n03609.name: Apical membrane trafficking in ductal epithelia (CFTR anion-water secretion, membrane rafts, pancreatic duct)
n03609.rationale: Members build and use the polarized surface of secretory ductal epithelia for CFTR-driven fluid secretion, unlike confusables on ion channels, tight junctions or lipid flippases.

n03491.head: HGF-MET and TGF-beta/activin receptor signaling
n03491.name: HGF-MET and TGF-beta/activin receptor signaling (cancer mutants, TGFBR3 co-receptor, AMH receptor)
n03491.rationale: Members split between HGF-MET (and MSP) receptor tyrosine kinase signaling and TGF-beta/activin/AMH receptor-SMAD signaling with cancer mutants, with no single shared process; the TGF-beta half separates it from PTK6, liver and RTK confusables.

n01367.head: Monocyte-macrophage differentiation
n01367.name: Monocyte-macrophage differentiation (M-CSF signaling, macrophage proliferation, myeloid dendritic cells)
n01367.rationale: Members promote M-CSF-driven monocyte, macrophage and myeloid dendritic cell development, unlike the granulocyte and interleukin-signaling confusables.

n00104.head: MITF-M-dependent gene regulation
n00104.name: MITF-M-dependent gene regulation (non-pigmentation targets, invasion and proliferation, lysosome and metabolism)
n00104.rationale: Members are MITF-M control and its target programmes outside pigmentation, which separates the theme from melanin and pigmentation confusables.

n03660.head: RNA polymerase II elongation control
n03660.name: RNA polymerase II elongation control (promoter escape, pausing, termination)
n03660.rationale: Most members govern Pol II passage from promoter clearance through pausing, elongation and termination (two translation-elongation terms are minor outliers), unlike broader RNA processing and Pol I/III confusables.

n04077.head: Nutrient-sensing transcriptional control of metabolism
n04077.name: Nutrient-sensing transcriptional control of metabolism (lipogenesis and gluconeogenesis, ChREBP/SREBP/LXR, circadian clock)
n04077.rationale: Members are sugar-, lipid- and energy-sensing transcriptional regulators of lipid and glucose metabolism, distinct from adipogenesis, glucagon-PKA and cholesterol-SREBP confusables.

n00470.head: Mitochondrial protein import
n00470.name: Mitochondrial protein import (outer membrane, matrix)
n00470.rationale: Members deliver proteins across the outer membrane into the matrix, unlike confusables on mitochondrial protein processing, degradation or respiratory complex assembly.

n00936.head: Death receptor-induced extrinsic apoptosis
n00936.name: Death receptor-induced extrinsic apoptosis (Fas and TRAIL, caspase-8 and c-FLIP, BID)
n00936.rationale: Members form the Fas/TRAIL to caspase-8 apoptotic route and its c-FLIP control, separate from necroptosis and intrinsic mitochondrial apoptosis confusables.

n00567.head: Rho subfamily GTPase cycle
n00567.name: Rho subfamily GTPase cycle (RhoA, RhoB, RhoC)
n00567.rationale: Members are the GTPase cycles of the three Rho subfamily members, distinct from Rac, Cdc42 and atypical Rho confusables.

n01563.head: Stress and innate motivated behavior
n01563.name: Stress and innate motivated behavior (glucocorticoid-CRH response, fear, reproductive and aggressive behavior)
n01563.rationale: Members are innate behaviors and behavioral stress responses (mating, parenting, aggression, drinking, fear, CRH/corticosterone), unlike confusables on neuropeptide signaling, HPA secretion, sleep or drug reward.

n04381.head: Endocrine hormone synthesis and signaling
n04381.name: Endocrine hormone synthesis and signaling (adrenal-gonadal steroidogenesis, thyroid hormone, GH-prolactin-leptin)
n04381.rationale: Members make or respond to classical endocrine hormones, distinguishing the theme from vitamin A/D/K and phosphate-mineral confusables and from GH-secretion/amino-acid transport.

n00304.head: Branched-chain amino acid catabolism
n00304.name: Branched-chain amino acid catabolism (leucine, valine, organic acidurias)
n00304.rationale: Members are leucine and valine breakdown steps and their inborn errors, unlike confusables featuring isoleucine, biotin or short-chain fatty acid metabolism.

n03620.head: Proteotoxic stress response
n03620.name: Proteotoxic stress response (HSF1 heat shock, stress granules, mitochondrial UPR)
n03620.rationale: Members respond to protein-damaging stress via HSF1 refolding, stress granules and UPRmt, unlike confusables on chaperonin folding, the ER UPR or aggrephagy.

n04584.head: RIG-I-like receptor antiviral signaling
n04584.name: RIG-I-like receptor antiviral signaling (feedback regulation, NF-kB and IRF3 output, dsRNA sensing)
n04584.rationale: Members are cytosolic RNA sensing by RIG-I/MDA5 and its positive and negative regulation, distinct from TLR, cGAS-STING and broader interferon response confusables.

n01673.head: Triglyceride-rich lipoprotein metabolism
n01673.name: Triglyceride-rich lipoprotein metabolism (chylomicron and VLDL assembly, lipolysis, clearance)
n01673.rationale: Members cover dietary fat absorption and the assembly, lipase remodeling and clearance of chylomicrons and VLDL, unlike LDL/HDL remodeling and phospholipase confusables.

n03887.head: TCA cycle and 2-oxoacid dehydrogenases
n03887.name: TCA cycle and 2-oxoacid dehydrogenases (protein lipoylation, Fe-S cluster assembly, lysine/glycine catabolism)
n03887.rationale: Members are TCA reactions and the lipoylated, Fe-S-dependent enzymes that feed and run them, distinct from CoA/PDH regulation and serine/vitamin B6 confusables.

n00150.head: Epithelial hexose transport
n00150.name: Epithelial hexose transport (intestinal absorption, renal glucose reabsorption, SGLT/GLUT defects)
n00150.rationale: Members move glucose, galactose and fructose across gut and kidney epithelia and their inherited defects, unlike carbohydrate digestion, galactose catabolism, urate and amino acid transport confusables.

n03848.head: Canonical NF-kappaB activation via RIP1
n03848.name: Canonical NF-kappaB activation via RIP1 (TNFR1 signaling, linear ubiquitination, TLR4-TRIF)
n03848.rationale: Members are RIP1-dependent IKK recruitment downstream of TNFR1 and TLR4, separating the theme from non-canonical NF-kB, IRAK-dependent TLR and negative-regulation confusables.

n01515.head: Lysosomal glycosphingolipid catabolism
n01515.name: Lysosomal glycosphingolipid catabolism (gangliosidoses, sialidosis, glycolipid transport)
n01515.rationale: Members degrade and move glycosphingolipids through the lysosome, unlike glycosphingolipid biosynthesis and sialic acid/N-glycan confusables.

n02234.head: Ras-ERK signal regulation
n02234.name: Ras-ERK signal regulation (phosphatase attenuation, RSK activation, p38 via RIT/RIN)
n02234.rationale: Members tune Ras-MAPK signaling up and down and carry its RSK and p38 outputs, distinct from confusables on RAF activation, RAS mutants and GAP-mediated control.

n02034.head: ER-Golgi vesicle trafficking
n02034.name: ER-Golgi vesicle trafficking (COPI budding, Golgi-to-ER retrograde transport, vesicle targeting)
n02034.rationale: All members concern vesicle traffic between ER and Golgi; COPI budding and retrograde transport separate it from the COPII/ER-export and tethering neighbours.

n03117.head: Sensorimotor behaviour and motor control
n03117.name: Sensorimotor behaviour and motor control (locomotion, proprioception, glycinergic inhibition)
n03117.rationale: Members are neural control of movement and sensation (locomotion, reflexes, touch, vision, inhibitory transmission; one neural RNA-binding module is a loose fit); glycinergic inhibition and proprioception separate it from the exploratory/vocal behaviour and neuronal excitability neighbours.

n01095.head: Gonadotropin and GnRH signaling
n01095.name: Gonadotropin and GnRH signaling (FSH, LH, glycoprotein hormone receptors)
n01095.rationale: Members are cellular responses to GnRH, FSH and LH and their glycoprotein hormone receptors, unlike neighbours centred on gonadotropin secretion, activin and gonadal development.

n01092.head: Alpha-2 adrenergic inhibitory signaling
n01092.name: Alpha-2 adrenergic inhibitory signaling (Gi/Gz adenylate cyclase inhibition, catecholamine release, insulin secretion)
n01092.rationale: Alpha-2 adrenoceptors couple through Gi/Gz to inhibit adenylate cyclase and suppress catecholamine and insulin secretion; the secretion arm and Gz separate it from generic cAMP and adrenoceptor neighbours.

n00800.head: Gap junction coupling in cardiac conduction
n00800.name: Gap junction coupling in cardiac conduction
n00800.rationale: All members concern electrical coupling via gap junctions in cardiac conduction, which no neighbour (depolarisation, conduction system development) covers.

n02504.head: Synaptic vesicle recycling
n02504.name: Synaptic vesicle recycling (clathrin-mediated endocytosis, active zone, vesicle clustering)
n02504.rationale: Members regulate the presynaptic vesicle cycle with clathrin coat assembly and endocytosis, distinguishing it from neighbours on release, docking and priming or postsynaptic receptor trafficking.

n00264.head: 12-lipoxygenase eicosanoid synthesis
n00264.name: 12-lipoxygenase eicosanoid synthesis (hepoxilins, trioxilins, 12-HETE)
n00264.rationale: All members are 12-lipoxygenase products of arachidonate, separating it from 5-/15-lipoxygenase, lipoxin and skin-barrier lipid neighbours.

n00269.head: Cytoskeletal organelle transport
n00269.name: Cytoskeletal organelle transport (axonal and dendritic cargo, mitochondria, endolysosomes)
n00269.rationale: Members move organelles and vesicles along microtubules and actin, notably in neurons, plus endolysosome size; unlike neighbours on microtubule modification, kinesins or lysosomal fusion.

n03163.head: Stress response and survival signaling
n03163.name: Stress response and survival signaling (unfolded protein response, integrated stress response, AKT-FOXO)
n03163.rationale: Members are ER/mitochondrial unfolded protein and eIF2-kinase stress responses and AKT-FOXO survival-versus-apoptosis control; AKT-FOXO separates it from ER folding neighbours and the UPR/ISR from NRF2 neighbours.

n04222.head: Immunoregulatory cytokine signaling
n04222.name: Immunoregulatory cytokine signaling (IL-10/IL-12 families, IL-15/IL-21 on NK/NKT, interferon-lambda)
n04222.rationale: Members are IL-10/IL-20, IL-12/23/27/35, IL-15/21 and type III interferon signaling with NK/NKT regulation; IL-15/21, NK/NKT and interferon-lambda separate it from the broader Th2/IL-6 and IL-17/IL-33 cytokine neighbours.

n02892.head: Mesenchymal progenitor fate signaling
n02892.name: Mesenchymal progenitor fate signaling (TGF-beta/activin, BMP, Wnt)
n02892.rationale: Members are morphogen signals driving mesenchymal stem cell proliferation and differentiation, upstream of the osteoblast and cadherin neighbours.

n01968.head: Differentiated intestinal epithelial identity
n01968.name: Differentiated intestinal epithelial identity (CDX-driven, absorptive enterocytes, barrier maintenance)
n01968.rationale: Members mark the CDX-specified differentiated gut epithelium and its barrier (leukocyte migration is a stray member); CDX and differentiation separate it from HNF4 hepatic-intestinal, crypt stem and antimicrobial neighbours.

n03392.head: Peroxisome function
n03392.name: Peroxisome function (protein import, very-long-chain fatty acid oxidation)
n03392.rationale: Members cover peroxisome biogenesis (import, fission) and its very-long-chain beta-oxidation; combining both separates it from neighbours with only fatty acid oxidation or only import plus pexophagy.

n03733.head: Glycan elongation and sialylation
n03733.name: Glycan elongation and sialylation (N- and O-glycans, gangliosides, sialic acid synthesis)
n03733.rationale: Members build and sialylate N-, O-glycan and ganglioside chains with CMP-sialic acid supply; gangliosides and sialic acid synthesis separate it from fucosylation, nucleotide-sugar and early N-glycan neighbours.

n03825.head: Myeloid cell identity signatures
n03825.name: Myeloid cell identity signatures (circulating monocytes, resting dendritic cells, surface markers)
n03825.rationale: Members are monocyte, dendritic cell and related myeloid signatures; resting surface identity separates it from monocyte activation and antigen-presentation neighbours.

n00091.head: Pro-resolving lipid mediator biosynthesis
n00091.name: Pro-resolving lipid mediator biosynthesis (resolvins, protectins, maresins)
n00091.rationale: All members synthesise specialised pro-resolving mediators from DHA, EPA and DPA, unlike the arachidonate lipoxin, HETE and leukotriene neighbours.

n02423.head: Renal epithelial specialization
n02423.name: Renal epithelial specialization (podocyte filtration barrier, brush-border microvilli, albumin reabsorption)
n02423.rationale: Members build the glomerular podocyte barrier and the tubular brush border that reabsorbs albumin; the microvillus and podocyte parts separate it from glomerular vasculature/mesangium and generic polarity neighbours.

n01692.head: DNA double-strand break response
n01692.name: DNA double-strand break response (break sensing, ATM signaling, classical end joining)
n01692.rationale: Members sense breaks, recruit ATM-phosphorylated factors and repair by classical NHEJ, separating it from homologous recombination, alt-NHEJ and ADP-ribosylation neighbours.

n00321.head: Mitotic sister chromatid cohesion and separation
n00321.name: Mitotic sister chromatid cohesion and separation (centromeric cohesion, anaphase release)
n00321.rationale: Members maintain centromeric cohesion and resolve it at anaphase, unlike neighbours on cohesion establishment, APC/C or spindle checkpoint.

n02475.head: Polyubiquitin chain assembly and editing
n02475.name: Polyubiquitin chain assembly and editing (atypical K6/K27/K29 linkages, E1-E2 enzymes, deubiquitinases)
n02475.rationale: Members write and erase linkage-specific ubiquitin chains; atypical linkages and free chains separate it from NF-kB, proteasome/neddylation and E3-ligase neighbours.

n01104.head: Lipoate-dependent dehydrogenase complexes
n01104.name: Lipoate-dependent dehydrogenase complexes (protein lipoylation, 2-oxoacid dehydrogenases, glycine cleavage)
n01104.rationale: Members share lipoylated E2/DLD complexes (PDH, OGDH, 2-oxoadipate for lysine catabolism, glycine cleavage), separating it from TCA, CoA, BCKDH and GABA neighbours.

n02004.head: Eye morphogenesis
n02004.name: Eye morphogenesis (lens and anterior segment, optic cup, retinal vascular barrier)
n02004.rationale: Members build eye structures and retinal vasculature with its blood-retinal barrier, unlike neighbours on retinal neuron and photoreceptor differentiation or phototransduction.

n03891.head: Innate bacterial sensing
n03891.name: Innate bacterial sensing (TLR2/4/5-MyD88, NOD1/2, inflammasome)
n03891.rationale: Members detect bacterial cell-wall ligands via TLR-MyD88/IRAK4 and NOD1/2; having both arms separates it from TLR-only and TAK1/ALPK1 neighbours.

n03635.head: Glycolysis to lactate
n03635.name: Glycolysis to lactate (hexokinase, fructose 2,6-bisphosphate regulation)
n03635.rationale: Members are glucose fermentation to lactate and its fructose bisphosphate control (oxygen transport is a stray member), unlike the gluconeogenesis, PPP-regulation and creatine neighbours.

n04181.head: Mitotic exit
n04181.name: Mitotic exit (ESCRT-III nuclear envelope resealing, abscission, endoreduplication)
n04181.rationale: Members complete or bypass mitosis via ESCRT-III envelope sealing and abscission; ESCRT and endoreduplication separate it from contractile ring, spindle and condensation neighbours.

n03237.head: Rap1-mediated integrin activation
n03237.name: Rap1-mediated integrin activation (endothelial shear stress, platelet activation, PIEZO1)
n03237.rationale: Members converge on Rap1-driven inside-out integrin activation and its cytoskeletal coupling; the shear-stress and platelet contexts separate it from the Rho/focal-adhesion, leukocyte-adhesion and platelet-GPCR neighbours.

n02190.head: Neurotrophin receptor downstream signaling
n02190.name: Neurotrophin receptor downstream signaling (TRKA, TRKC, Ras-MAPK-CREB)
n02190.rationale: All members are effector branches of TRK neurotrophin receptors; naming TRKA and TRKC with Ras-MAPK-CREB outputs separates it from the TRKB/BDNF and NGF-activation/retrograde neighbours.

n02008.head: De novo glycerophospholipid synthesis and turnover
n02008.name: De novo glycerophospholipid synthesis and turnover (PC/PE/PS, PG-cardiolipin, lysophospholipid hydrolysis)
n02008.rationale: Members build PC, PE, PS, PG and cardiolipin via CDP routes and degrade lysophospholipids, distinguishing it from neighbours centred on acyl-chain remodelling, PI synthesis/transport and endocannabinoids.

n01529.head: Cardiac impulse conduction
n01529.name: Cardiac impulse conduction (depolarization, SA node pacemaking, gap junction coupling)
n01529.rationale: Members cover depolarization and electrical spread through nodal, His-Purkinje and working myocardium, unlike neighbours on repolarization/potassium channels or conduction-system development.

n03438.head: Kidney epithelial polarity and specialization
n03438.name: Kidney epithelial polarity and specialization (brush border, tight junctions, podocyte slit diaphragm)
n03438.rationale: Members establish apical-basal polarity and its specializations in tubular and glomerular epithelium, separating it from apical trafficking, glomerular vasculature/mesangium and adherens-junction neighbours.

n00107.head: Endocannabinoid metabolism and signaling
n00107.name: Endocannabinoid metabolism and signaling (anandamide, 2-AG, retrograde synaptic signaling)
n00107.rationale: Members make and degrade N-acylethanolamines and 2-AG and use them as retrograde synaptic lipid messengers, distinct from the eicosanoid, histamine and leukotriene neighbours.

n03464.head: Axon pathfinding
n03464.name: Axon pathfinding (midline crossing, chemorepulsion, neuron-type-specific tracts)
n03464.rationale: Members guide axons of commissural, retinal, dopaminergic and serotonergic neurons through repulsive and midline cues, rather than the SLIT-ROBO, ephrin, netrin or semaphorin signalling detail held by neighbours.

n01019.head: Cullin neddylation and deneddylation
n01019.name: Cullin neddylation and deneddylation (COP9 signalosome, CUL1 substrate degradation)
n01019.rationale: Members form the NEDD8 on/off cycle that controls cullin-RING ligases, distinct from neighbours on deubiquitination, ubiquitin chain types and PD-L1 degradation.

n03239.head: Restraint of VEGF-driven angiogenic sprouting
n03239.name: Restraint of VEGF-driven angiogenic sprouting (Tie2, endothelial survival, adherens junctions)
n03239.rationale: Members hold endothelium quiescent by limiting VEGFR2-driven sprouting while Tie2 supports survival and junctions, unlike the pro-angiogenic, cell-matrix and VEGF-production neighbours.

n03902.head: Nuclear RNA export
n03902.name: Nuclear RNA export (mRNA, tRNA, ribosomal subunits)
n03902.rationale: Members move mature RNAs and pre-ribosomes out through the nuclear pore, separating it from the RNA processing, decay and nuclear pore assembly/protein-import neighbours.

n04569.head: Transcription elongation and termination
n04569.name: Transcription elongation and termination (RNA polymerase I, RNA polymerase III, early rRNA processing)
n04569.rationale: Members are the elongation and termination steps of Pol I and Pol III transcription plus 5'-ETS processing, distinct from neighbours on initiation and rRNA regulation.

n00911.head: Blood coagulation and fibrinolysis
n00911.name: Blood coagulation and fibrinolysis (common pathway, fibrin formation, factor V defects)
n00911.rationale: Members form and dissolve fibrin clots via the common pathway with factor V variants, unlike neighbours on the intrinsic/FXII contact pathway, factor VIII/IX defects or VWF.

n01571.head: Monoamine neurotransmitter metabolism and transport
n01571.name: Monoamine neurotransmitter metabolism and transport (catecholamines, serotonin, sympathoadrenal development)
n01571.rationale: Members synthesize, package, reuptake and degrade catecholamines and serotonin, with sympathoadrenal development separating it from the broader neurotransmitter-transport and dopamine-receptor neighbours.

n00923.head: Platelet activation
n00923.name: Platelet activation (cytoskeletal remodeling)
n00923.rationale: The three expression modules capture platelet activation with its cytoskeletal reorganization, unlike neighbours on fibroblast matrix adhesion and integrin-Rap1 signalling.

n03294.head: Glycine-centred amino acid metabolism
n03294.name: Glycine-centred amino acid metabolism (threonine, proline, aromatic acid conjugation)
n03294.rationale: Members make and degrade glycine (via threonine and glyoxylate), handle proline and use glycine or glutamine to conjugate aromatic acids, distinct from sulfur/aromatic, glutamate and alanine neighbours.

n02900.head: Intrinsic mitochondrial apoptosis
n02900.name: Intrinsic mitochondrial apoptosis (p53, BCL-2 family, apoptosome)
n02900.rationale: Members run the p53-induced BCL-2 family decision, cytochrome c release and apoptosome-caspase activation, distinct from p53 cell-cycle/senescence and apoptosis-execution neighbours.

n02830.head: PLC-IP3 calcium signaling
n02830.name: PLC-IP3 calcium signaling (G protein-coupled receptors, noncanonical Wnt/Ca2+, LPA receptors)
n02830.rationale: Members raise cytosolic calcium through phospholipase C and IP3 downstream of GPCRs and Wnt/Ca2+, separating it from cAMP, PKC, eicosanoid-receptor and purinergic neighbours.

n00389.head: Glutamate reuptake
n00389.name: Glutamate reuptake (astrocytic glutamate-glutamine cycle)
n00389.rationale: Members clear synaptic glutamate into astrocytes for recycling via glutamine, distinct from monoamine, GABA and aspartate transporter neighbours.

n00280.head: Nuclear export of mature mRNA
n00280.name: Nuclear export of mature mRNA
n00280.rationale: All members export processed mRNAs from the nucleus, distinct from neighbours on mRNA processing and nuclear pore complex organization.

n00705.head: Gastrulation and germ layer formation
n00705.name: Gastrulation and germ layer formation (definitive endoderm, lateral mesoderm, early gut)
n00705.rationale: Members cover exit from pluripotency, primitive streak EMT and germ-layer specification through early gut morphogenesis, unlike the heart and pancreas development neighbours.

n00766.head: Pyroptotic cell death execution
n00766.name: Pyroptotic cell death execution (gasdermin pores, pyroptosis defects)
n00766.rationale: Members are the lytic execution of pyroptosis and its defects, downstream of the inflammasome assembly held by neighbours.

n00174.head: JNK stress-activated kinase cascade activation
n00174.name: JNK stress-activated kinase cascade activation
n00174.rationale: All members positively regulate the JNK stress kinase cascade, distinct from NF-kappaB, NOD and TAK1-upstream neighbours.

n01493.head: DNA structural remodeling in genome maintenance
n01493.name: DNA structural remodeling in genome maintenance (topology, fork reversal, protein-DNA disassembly)
n01493.rationale: Members change DNA topology and structure during replication and repair, unlike neighbours on chromatin remodelling, telomere maintenance or replication stress.

n04107.head: Synapse assembly and receptor clustering
n04107.name: Synapse assembly and receptor clustering (neurexin-neuroligin, NMDA/PSD-95, GABA/gephyrin)
n04107.rationale: Members build pre- and postsynaptic membranes and cluster excitatory and inhibitory receptors, distinct from neighbours on SALM and receptor phosphatase synaptic adhesion.

n01452.head: Type 2 eosinophilic inflammation
n01452.name: Type 2 eosinophilic inflammation (Th2 differentiation, IL-5, eosinophil recruitment)
n01452.rationale: Members promote Th2 cells and IL-5 that drive eosinophil migration and activation, unlike neighbours on negative Th2 regulation, IL-4/IL-13/IL-33 signalling or granulocyte differentiation.

n02439.head: Regulation of kidney development
n02439.name: Regulation of kidney development (kidney size restraint, nephric duct and ureter, mesenchyme survival)
n02439.rationale: All members regulate kidney development, and the restraint of growth and size, nephric duct-ureter morphogenesis and mesenchymal anti-apoptosis separate it from the ureteric bud and metanephric differentiation confusables.

n03058.head: Reelin signalling in synapse maturation
n03058.name: Reelin signalling in synapse maturation (dendritic spines, dendrite development, long-term depression)
n03058.rationale: Reelin signalling drives dendrite, spine and synapse maturation and plasticity, which separates it from the amyloid-beta and actin-based postsynaptic structure confusables.

n02680.head: Glucogenic amino acid metabolism and gluconeogenesis
n02680.name: Glucogenic amino acid metabolism and gluconeogenesis (glutamate and glutamine, aspartate, alanine)
n02680.rationale: Glutamate, glutamine, aspartate and alanine metabolism feed carbon via oxaloacetate into gluconeogenesis, distinguishing it from the proline/glycine, TCA cycle and conjugation confusables.

n00953.head: Sphingolipid metabolism
n00953.name: Sphingolipid metabolism (ceramide, sphingomyelin)
n00953.rationale: Members cover sphingolipid synthesis, breakdown and homeostasis centred on ceramide and sphingomyelin, unlike the glycerophospholipid confusables.

n00671.head: Lipoprotein particle remodeling
n00671.name: Lipoprotein particle remodeling (HDL, LDL)
n00671.rationale: All members are remodeling of HDL and LDL particles, which separates it from the chylomicron and VLDL assembly and clearance confusables.

n01216.head: Mitochondrial gene expression and genome maintenance
n01216.name: Mitochondrial gene expression and genome maintenance (mtDNA replication, mRNA turnover, mitoribosome translation)
n01216.rationale: Members span mitochondrial DNA replication and repair, transcription, mRNA stability and mitoribosome translation, whereas the confusables add tRNA processing and RNA import.

n02416.head: Neuropeptide signalling in sleep-wake regulation
n02416.name: Neuropeptide signalling in sleep-wake regulation (opioid receptors, orexin, dense-core vesicle release)
n02416.rationale: Neuropeptide and opioid GPCR signalling released from dense-core vesicles, chiefly controlling sleep and wakefulness, distinguishes it from the stress-hormone and social/mating behaviour confusables.

n00965.head: Response to replication-blocking DNA damage
n00965.name: Response to replication-blocking DNA damage (protein-DNA crosslinks, camptothecin, hydroxyurea)
n00965.rationale: Protein-DNA crosslink repair and responses to camptothecin and hydroxyurea all deal with lesions that stall replication, unlike the Fanconi, double-strand break and fork-reversal confusables.

n02089.head: Inflammatory monocyte recruitment and activation
n02089.name: Inflammatory monocyte recruitment and activation (chemotaxis and extravasation, aggregation, proinflammatory cytokines)
n02089.rationale: Members describe monocyte activation, aggregation and migration into inflamed tissue together with the inflammatory cytokine response, which separates it from monocyte surface-signature and anti-inflammatory confusables.

n02561.head: Intrinsic pathway coagulation
n02561.name: Intrinsic pathway coagulation (defective factor VIII, defective factor IX)
n02561.rationale: Members are the intrinsic coagulation pathway and its factor VIII and IX variant defects, distinguishing it from the factor XII, von Willebrand factor, factor V and fibrinolysis confusables.

n03229.head: Endothelial specification and vascular morphogenesis
n03229.name: Endothelial specification and vascular morphogenesis (VEGFR2, Tie2, arterial-venous-lymphatic fate)
n03229.rationale: Members cover endothelial fate commitment and vessel formation driven by VEGFR2 and Tie2 signalling, unlike the sprouting-angiogenesis and BMP-driven cardiac vessel confusables.

n02651.head: Cardiomyocyte calcium homeostasis
n02651.name: Cardiomyocyte calcium homeostasis (sodium-calcium exchange, cytosolic calcium clearance)
n02651.rationale: Members control cardiac calcium handling with emphasis on sodium-calcium exchange lowering cytosolic calcium, which the SR pump, ryanodine-receptor and caffeine-response confusables lack.

n03855.head: Damaged-protein repair under cellular stress
n03855.name: Damaged-protein repair under cellular stress (methylglyoxal glycation, nitrosative stress, chaperone-mediated autophagy)
n03855.rationale: Members protect and repair proteins under stress, with methylglyoxal handling and protein repair distinguishing it from the aggrephagy, heat-shock and ROS detoxification confusables.

n00413.head: Hindbrain branchiomotor neuron development
n00413.name: Hindbrain branchiomotor neuron development (tangential migration, facial nerve, trigeminal nerve)
n00413.rationale: Branchiomotor neuron migration and axon guidance build the facial and trigeminal nerves, unlike the brainstem maturation, cerebellar and sensory placode confusables.

n02001.head: Differentiated intestinal epithelium identity
n02001.name: Differentiated intestinal epithelium identity (CDX and HNF4 factors, enterocytes, barrier maintenance)
n02001.rationale: Members mark the CDX/HNF4-specified differentiated absorptive gut epithelium and its barrier, distinguishing it from the crypt stem cell, antimicrobial and pancreatic lineage confusables.

n03030.head: Chemokine receptor-driven leukocyte chemotaxis
n03030.name: Chemokine receptor-driven leukocyte chemotaxis (dendritic cells, T and NK cells, CCR7 and CXCR4)
n03030.rationale: Chemokine receptor signalling directs dendritic cell, T cell and NK cell migration, which separates it from the integrin, B cell homing and monocyte confusables.

n02751.head: Amino acid and oligopeptide transport
n02751.name: Amino acid and oligopeptide transport (proton-coupled oligopeptide cotransport, cationic amino acids)
n02751.rationale: Members move amino acids and di/oligopeptides across membranes, and proton-coupled peptide transport and cationic amino acid import distinguish it from the neutral amino acid, polyamine and ornithine confusables.

n02434.head: Epithelial cell migration control
n02434.name: Epithelial cell migration control (reduced cell-matrix adhesion, Rho and Rac inhibition, keratinocytes)
n02434.rationale: Members tune epithelial and keratinocyte migration by suppressing matrix adhesion, spreading and Rho/Rac-driven protrusion, unlike the CDC42/actin-polymerization and VEGF confusables.

n02028.head: Double-strand break sensing and repair choice
n02028.name: Double-strand break sensing and repair choice (NHEJ, ATM signalling, BRCA1 and BRCA2 defects)
n02028.rationale: Members sense breaks, signal via ATM and choose between NHEJ and homologous recombination including BRCA1/BRCA2 defects, distinguishing it from the PARylation and resection/HR-execution confusables.

n00627.head: Golgi nucleotide-sugar transport
n00627.name: Golgi nucleotide-sugar transport (SLC35 transporter defects, congenital glycosylation disorders, UDP-glucuronate)
n00627.rationale: Members supply nucleotide sugars to the Golgi lumen and include transporter defects causing glycosylation disorders, unlike the GPI, glycosphingolipid, sialic acid and N-glycan confusables.

n01173.head: Hematopoietic interleukin receptor signalling
n01173.name: Hematopoietic interleukin receptor signalling (IL-2/7/9, IL-3/5, STAT5)
n01173.rationale: Members are common gamma-chain and beta-common interleukin receptor signalling through STAT5, with the IL-3/IL-5 arm separating it from the IL-15/21 T cell, IL-6 and FLT3 confusables.

n01164.head: Purine ribonucleotide catabolism
n01164.name: Purine ribonucleotide catabolism (AMP and IMP, ADA and PNP defects, allantoin)
n01164.rationale: Members degrade purine ribonucleotides and nucleosides via inosine towards allantoin, unlike the salvage and deoxyribonucleotide confusables.

n01303.head: Chemosensory perception
n01303.name: Chemosensory perception (smell, sour taste)
n01303.rationale: Members are chemical sensing by smell and sour taste, distinguishing it from olfactory receptor expression, acid-sensing channel and sweet/bitter/umami taste confusables.

n03115.head: AP-1 immediate-early gene response
n03115.name: AP-1 immediate-early gene response (UV, nitric oxide, mitogens and phorbol ester)
n03115.rationale: AP-1/FOS-driven immediate-early transcription in response to UV, nitric oxide and mitogenic stimuli distinguishes it from the TAK1-JNK/p38 kinase and ERK feedback confusables.

n00440.head: Regulation of nucleocytoplasmic protein transport
n00440.name: Regulation of nucleocytoplasmic protein transport (nuclear import, nuclear export)
n00440.rationale: Members regulate protein import into and export from the nucleus, unlike the nuclear pore assembly and RNA/inositol phosphate transport confusables.

n01383.head: Oncogenic RTK mutants and TKI resistance
n01383.name: Oncogenic RTK mutants and TKI resistance (KIT and PDGFR, ALK, FGFR)
n01383.rationale: All members are signaling by cancer-mutant, fused or amplified receptor tyrosine kinases and their resistance to kinase inhibitors; KIT/PDGFR, ALK and FGFR separate it from the FLT3, ERBB2 and cytokine-receptor neighbours.

n01186.head: Neutral amino acid transport
n01186.name: Neutral amino acid transport (SLC6A19, Hartnup disorder)
n01186.rationale: Plasma-membrane uptake of neutral amino acids such as tryptophan and glycine, centred on SLC6A19 and its Hartnup defects, which distinguishes it from the broader amino acid, peptide and SLC6A20/SLC36A2 transport neighbours.

n04360.head: Immune cell surface marker signatures
n04360.name: Immune cell surface marker signatures (B cells, T cells, dendritic cells)
n04360.rationale: Surface-protein signatures of leukocytes, mostly B cell with CD4 T cell and dendritic cell sets; the B cell plus T/DC mix separates it from neighbours centred on plasma cells, monocytes or antigen presentation.

n00293.head: Leloir pathway galactose catabolism
n00293.name: Leloir pathway galactose catabolism (inherited galactosemias)
n00293.rationale: Galactose breakdown via UDP-galactose and the GALK1, GALT, GALE and GALM deficiencies, distinct from the fructose, pentose and alditol neighbours.

n01194.head: Presynaptic catecholamine reuptake
n01194.name: Presynaptic catecholamine reuptake (dopamine transporter, norepinephrine transporter)
n01194.rationale: Clearance of dopamine and norepinephrine from the synapse by SLC6A3 and SLC6A2 and their disease variants, distinct from vesicular loading, catecholamine degradation and dopamine synthesis/signaling neighbours.

n04334.head: Regulation of intrinsic and extrinsic apoptosis
n04334.name: Regulation of intrinsic and extrinsic apoptosis (oxidative stress, death receptors, ligand deprivation)
n04334.rationale: Control of apoptotic signaling triggered by peroxide, oxidative stress and hypoxia or by death receptors and dependence-receptor ligand absence; the apoptosis focus and extrinsic arm separate it from oxidative-stress response and ferroptosis neighbours.

n03564.head: Cullin-RING ligase control of protein stability
n03564.name: Cullin-RING ligase control of protein stability (neddylation, RHOBTB adaptors, PD-L1 in tumor immunity)
n03564.rationale: Neddylation/deneddylation of cullin ligases and the substrate turnover they drive, with PD-L1 stability and anti-tumor T cell response as the main readout; distinct from general ubiquitination, PD-L1 transcription and proteolysis neighbours.

n02502.head: Visceral smooth muscle contraction and relaxation
n02502.name: Visceral smooth muscle contraction and relaxation (gastrointestinal motility, micturition, tachykinins)
n02502.rationale: Contractility of gut and urinary tract smooth muscle with stomach function and tachykinin input, distinct from reproductive smooth muscle, histamine and serotonin neighbours.

n02928.head: Glucagon and glucose-sensing metabolic control
n02928.name: Glucagon and glucose-sensing metabolic control (gluconeogenesis, ChREBP, triglyceride breakdown)
n02928.rationale: Hormonal (glucagon-PKA, PP2A, PDE3B) and glucose-sensing (ChREBP, carbon catabolite) control of gluconeogenesis and triglyceride use, distinct from insulin, glycogen, LXR lipogenesis and adipogenesis neighbours.

n00879.head: ERBB receptor adaptor signaling
n00879.name: ERBB receptor adaptor signaling (SHC1, GRB2)
n00879.rationale: SHC1 and GRB2 docking events downstream of EGFR, ERBB2 and ERBB4, distinct from neighbours with GRB7, PI3K, PLCG1 or ERBB3/4 dimer signaling.

n00469.head: Cardiomyocyte hypertrophic growth
n00469.name: Cardiomyocyte hypertrophic growth (cardiac muscle adaptation, sarcomere organization)
n00469.rationale: Regulation of cardiac muscle adaptation, cardiomyocyte growth and sarcomere assembly, distinct from skeletal muscle atrophy/hypertrophy, calcineurin and contractility neighbours.

n01459.head: RNA virus infection cycle
n01459.name: RNA virus infection cycle (entry, genome replication and translation, assembly)
n01459.rationale: Life-cycle stages and host interactions of coronaviruses, influenza, RSV, dengue and retroviral protein maturation, distinct from neighbours on DNA integration, reverse transcription, HCMV and latency.

n01436.head: Hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal stress axis
n01436.name: Hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal stress axis (corticotropin, glucocorticoid secretion and response)
n01436.rationale: CRH-ACTH control of cortisol/corticosterone secretion, glucocorticoid responses and stress behaviour, distinct from feeding, growth hormone, sleep and social-behaviour neuroendocrine neighbours.

n03786.head: Fc receptor signaling
n03786.name: Fc receptor signaling (mast cell activation, Fc-gamma phagocytosis, hypersensitivity)
n03786.rationale: Antibody Fc receptor signaling through FcERI in mast cells and FcGR in phagocytosis and ADCC, with hypersensitivity, distinct from B cell receptor and inhibitory-receptor neighbours.

n03008.head: Hard tissue mineralization
n03008.name: Hard tissue mineralization (bone, dentin, enamel and cementum, tooth development)
n03008.rationale: Mineralization of bone and dental tissues with odontogenesis and FGF23-Klotho/PTH inputs, distinct from phosphate-transporter and osteoclast/resorption neighbours.

n01253.head: Aromatic xenobiotic metabolism
n01253.name: Aromatic xenobiotic metabolism (CYP2E1 oxidation, N-acetylation, paracetamol)
n01253.rationale: Oxidation by CYP2E1 and N-acetylation of benzene-containing and nitrogenous compounds such as paracetamol, distinct from glycine conjugation, methylation/sulfonation and CYP1A2 neighbours.

n03134.head: Golgi glycoconjugate synthesis
n03134.name: Golgi glycoconjugate synthesis (nucleotide-sugar transporter defects, GDP-fucose, glycosphingolipids)
n03134.rationale: Supply of sugar donors to the Golgi (SLC35 transporter CDGs, SLC33A1, GDP-fucose) and Golgi glycosphingolipid synthesis, distinct from UDP-sugar, N-/O-glycan and PAPS neighbours.

n00140.head: Meiotic chromosome segregation and division
n00140.name: Meiotic chromosome segregation and division (oocyte spindle, cohesion, meiotic cell-cycle control)
n00140.rationale: Segregation and division steps of meiosis, mostly in oocytes, with cohesion and meiotic checkpoints, distinct from recombination, synapsis and male meiosis neighbours.

n03230.head: RUNX1-directed myeloid lineage specification
n03230.name: RUNX1-directed myeloid lineage specification (megakaryocytes, granulopoiesis, monocyte-macrophage restraint)
n03230.rationale: RUNX1-driven myeloid progenitor fate decisions toward megakaryocytes and granulocytes while restraining monocyte-macrophage fate, distinct from erythroid and stem cell homeostasis neighbours.

n02668.head: Axon guidance signaling
n02668.name: Axon guidance signaling (netrin-DCC, ephrin growth cone collapse, fasciculation)
n02668.rationale: Netrin-DCC attraction/repulsion and ephrin-induced growth cone collapse with RAC1 and fasciculation, distinct from SLIT-ROBO, L1 and ephrin cell-repulsion neighbours.

n00977.head: Alditol metabolism
n00977.name: Alditol metabolism (glycerol, glycerol-3-phosphate, polyol-pathway fructose synthesis)
n00977.rationale: Synthesis and breakdown of sugar alcohols including glycerol and sorbitol-to-fructose conversion, distinct from fructose catabolism disorders, pentose and acylglycerol neighbours.

n04349.head: Transepithelial water and solute transport
n04349.name: Transepithelial water and solute transport (aquaporins, paracellular magnesium, inositol)
n04349.rationale: Movement of water, magnesium, inositol and lipids across epithelial and blood-brain barriers via aquaporins, claudin paracellular routes and transporters, distinct from cation-chloride cotransporter and tight junction neighbours.

n00273.head: Second heart field cardiogenesis
n00273.name: Second heart field cardiogenesis (right ventricle formation, septal cell differentiation)
n00273.rationale: Specification and proliferation of second heart field progenitors forming the right ventricle and septum, distinct from trabeculation, heart tube and mesoderm-specification neighbours.

n00546.head: Constitutive oncogenic ERBB receptor signaling
n00546.name: Constitutive oncogenic ERBB receptor signaling (EGFR variants, ERBB2 domain mutants)
n00546.rationale: Ligand-independent signaling by EGFRvIII, cancer EGFR variants and ERBB2 domain mutants, distinct from ERBB2 drug-resistance and FGFR mutant neighbours.

n00463.head: Tubulin polyglutamylation cycle
n00463.name: Tubulin polyglutamylation cycle (microtubule severing and depolymerization)
n00463.rationale: Addition and removal of tubulin glutamate side chains and the severing/depolymerization they promote, distinct from centrosome, tubulin folding, kinesin transport and cilia neighbours.

n02108.head: Collagen synthesis and fibril assembly regulation
n02108.name: Collagen synthesis and fibril assembly regulation
n02108.rationale: Members are positive and negative control of collagen synthesis and fibril/matrix assembly; confusables instead add crosslinking, elastic fibres or collagen degradation.

n01770.head: Xenobiotic and steroid metabolism
n01770.name: Xenobiotic and steroid metabolism (cytochromes, sulfonation, flavones and glycosides)
n01770.rationale: Cytochrome and sulfotransferase biotransformation of xenobiotics and steroids; flavone metabolism and glycoside transport separate it from toxin/alkaloid/drug-ADME confusables.

n04224.head: Endocrine hormone axis regulation
n04224.name: Endocrine hormone axis regulation (thyroid hormone, HPA-glucocorticoid, leptin and growth)
n04224.rationale: Secretion and action of thyroid and adrenal glucocorticoid hormones plus leptin/growth signalling; thyroid content separates it from HPA-stress confusables and leptin from the steroidogenesis confusable.

n00843.head: Kidney development
n00843.name: Kidney development (nephron tubule patterning, nephric duct, intermediate mesoderm)
n00843.rationale: Embryonic kidney formation from intermediate mesoderm through nephric duct to segmented nephron tubules; confusables centre on ureteric bud branching, kidney size and proliferation/apoptosis.

n03100.head: Epithelial-mesenchymal signaling in organogenesis
n03100.name: Epithelial-mesenchymal signaling in organogenesis (lung, prostate, salivary and lacrimal glands)
n03100.rationale: Reciprocal epithelial-mesenchymal signalling shaping lung, trachea, prostate and exocrine glands; confusables are mammary, pancreatic and gonadal development.

n00492.head: FOXO transcription factor regulation
n00492.name: FOXO transcription factor regulation (AKT phosphorylation, acetylation, nuclear localization)
n00492.rationale: All members describe control of FOXO activity, chiefly by AKT; confusables are p53/mTORC1, NRF2 and metabolic transcription programmes.

n01656.head: Pituitary-testis gonadotropin axis
n01656.name: Pituitary-testis gonadotropin axis (FSH and LH secretion, Sertoli cell proliferation, seminiferous tubules)
n01656.rationale: Gonadotropin release and FSH action on Sertoli cells in seminiferous tubule development; confusables cover gonadotropin inhibition, activin or germ/Leydig cells.

n01009.head: Microtubule-based organelle transport
n01009.name: Microtubule-based organelle transport (mitochondria, synaptic vesicles, endolysosome size)
n01009.rationale: Microtubule-driven positioning of mitochondria and vesicles plus endosome/lysosome size control; confusables are autophagy-lysosome fusion or kinesin neuronal cargo without size control.

n00309.head: Type II sodium-phosphate cotransport
n00309.name: Type II sodium-phosphate cotransport (phosphate homeostasis, hypophosphatemic rickets, alveolar microlithiasis)
n00309.rationale: Type II Na+/Pi cotransporters, their regulation and hereditary defects; confusables are bicarbonate/anion exchangers and mineralization transporters.

n00513.head: Nephric duct and ureter morphogenesis
n00513.name: Nephric duct and ureter morphogenesis (epithelial tube formation, mesonephros)
n00513.rationale: Formation of the nephric duct and ureter epithelial tubes; confusables centre on ureteric bud budding, nephron development or kidney size.

n02509.head: Immunosuppressive cytokine signaling
n02509.name: Immunosuppressive cytokine signaling (IL-10, IL-27, IL-35)
n02509.rationale: IL-10-family regulatory cytokine signalling and control of IL-10/IL-12 production; confusables are IL-12/23/17 and fungal C-type lectin responses.

n03876.head: Myeloid lineage differentiation
n03876.name: Myeloid lineage differentiation (RUNX transcriptional control, granulocytes, megakaryocytes and erythrocytes)
n03876.rationale: Commitment and maturation of granulocyte, erythroid and megakaryocyte lineages under RUNX control; confusables are HSC maintenance/erythropoiesis or non-haematopoietic RUNX1 targets.

n01615.head: Caspase-8-controlled cell death
n01615.name: Caspase-8-controlled cell death (death receptor apoptosis, RIPK1 necroptosis, TLR3-TRIF)
n01615.rationale: Death-receptor and TRIF signals converging on caspase-8 to give apoptosis or RIPK1 necroptosis; confusables are mitochondrial, execution-phase or T-cell apoptosis.

n00864.head: Regulation of stress-induced intrinsic apoptosis
n00864.name: Regulation of stress-induced intrinsic apoptosis (hydrogen peroxide, hypoxia)
n00864.rationale: Positive and negative control of intrinsic apoptosis triggered by H2O2 and hypoxia; confusables are general oxidative stress responses, respiration or MOMP control.

n04470.head: Innate behaviour
n04470.name: Innate behaviour (mating and reproduction, social interaction, exploratory locomotion)
n04470.rationale: Innate behaviours spanning mating, social and exploratory locomotor acts; confusables lack the reproductive or locomotor parts and add sensory, drinking or learned behaviours.

n01003.head: Cardiac impulse conduction
n01003.name: Cardiac impulse conduction (phase 0 depolarization, gap-junction coupling, His-Purkinje)
n01003.rationale: Propagation of the cardiac action potential by fast depolarization and electrical coupling; confusables are SA-node pacemaking, repolarization or conduction-system development.

n02105.head: Postsynaptic neurotransmitter receptor trafficking
n02105.name: Postsynaptic neurotransmitter receptor trafficking (AMPA receptors, endosomal recycling, postsynaptic actin)
n02105.rationale: Endosomal internalization and recycling of postsynaptic receptors; confusables are presynaptic organization, BDNF signalling or AMPA clustering and plasticity.

n02433.head: Leak potassium control of nociception
n02433.name: Leak potassium control of nociception (K2P channels, resting potential, thermal and mechanical pain)
n02433.rationale: K2P leak channels setting resting potential in pain and temperature detection; confusables are TRP/tachykinin, Ca2+-activated K+ channels or itch and fever.

n01070.head: Coagulation and fibrinolysis
n01070.name: Coagulation and fibrinolysis (factor XII contact activation, plasma kallikrein, plasminogen activation)
n01070.rationale: Clot formation and dissolution with FXII-kallikrein contact activation; confusables are factor VIII/IX/V defects or von Willebrand factor variants.

n00438.head: Mitochondrial tRNA maturation
n00438.name: Mitochondrial tRNA maturation (3'-end processing, modification)
n00438.rationale: Processing and modification of mitochondrial tRNAs; confusables are aminoacylation, pseudouridylation, ribosome assembly or mRNA stability.

n01171.head: Endocardial cushion development
n01171.name: Endocardial cushion development (EMT, heart valves, cardiac septa)
n01171.rationale: Endocardial cushion EMT forming valves and septa; confusables are myocardial, heart-tube or ventricular morphogenesis.

n04399.head: Organelle positioning and ER network shaping
n04399.name: Organelle positioning and ER network shaping (kinesin transport, Miro GTPases, contact-site tethering)
n04399.rationale: Placement and shape of organelles by kinesin transport, Miro GTPases, ER tubule shaping and membrane tethering; contact-site tethering and ER shaping separate it from the transport and lipid-transfer confusables.

n04049.head: Nucleocytoplasmic transport and GTPase regulation
n04049.name: Nucleocytoplasmic transport and GTPase regulation (nuclear import, nuclear export, growth and cell-fate gene modules)
n04049.rationale: Most members regulate nuclear import/export and GTPase activity, but two gene modules on mTOR growth control and neuronal cell fate do not share that idea; confusables are nuclear pore, PML/senescence and viral host targeting.

n01821.head: Downstream antigen receptor signaling
n01821.name: Downstream antigen receptor signaling (second messengers, PKC, NF-κB and IL-2)
n01821.rationale: Signalling distal to TCR/BCR through second messengers and PKC to NF-κB and IL-2; confusables are proximal CD3/ZAP-70, CD28 costimulation or non-canonical NF-κB.

n01391.head: RNA polymerase II initiation-to-elongation transition
n01391.name: RNA polymerase II initiation-to-elongation transition (preinitiation complex assembly, promoter clearance, elongation activation)
n01391.rationale: Positive control of Pol II from preinitiation complex through promoter escape and pausing into elongation; confusables are negative elongation control and HIV transcription.

n00658.head: Phagosome maturation and its mycobacterial subversion
n00658.name: Phagosome maturation and its mycobacterial subversion (acidification, phagolysosome fusion, host defence evasion)
n00658.rationale: Members cover phagosome/endosome acidification and lysosome fusion together with the Mycobacterium tuberculosis strategies that block them and other host defences, which separates the theme from the toxin and bacterial-entry confusables.

n00079.head: Endocannabinoid retrograde synaptic signaling
n00079.name: Endocannabinoid retrograde synaptic signaling (diacylglycerol hydrolysis)
n00079.rationale: Diacylglycerol breakdown supplies 2-AG for retrograde lipid signaling at synapses, distinct from the DAG/TAG synthesis and neuropeptide confusables.

n02050.head: Cardiac outflow tract morphogenesis
n02050.name: Cardiac outflow tract morphogenesis (great and coronary arteries, semilunar valves, neural crest migration)
n02050.rationale: Members shape the arterial pole of the heart (pharyngeal arch, pulmonary and coronary arteries, aortic and pulmonary valves, outflow septation by neural crest), unlike the atrioventricular cushion and heart-tube confusables.

n03869.head: Nuclear RNA synthesis and processing
n03869.name: Nuclear RNA synthesis and processing (RNA polymerase I/III transcription, pre-mRNA splicing, nuclear RNA decay)
n03869.rationale: Members transcribe rRNA, tRNA and snRNA and process and degrade nuclear transcripts including splicing and histone pre-mRNA processing, distinguishing them from the translation, mRNA export and RNA modification confusables.

n00075.head: Glomerular vasculature development
n00075.name: Glomerular vasculature development (mesangial cells, endothelium)
n00075.rationale: All members build the glomerular capillary tuft through mesangial and endothelial development, whereas confusables concern general control of kidney growth and nephron tubules.

n00504.head: CFTR-mediated epithelial chloride and water transport
n00504.name: CFTR-mediated epithelial chloride and water transport (cystic fibrosis, CFTR trafficking)
n00504.rationale: Members concern CFTR-driven transepithelial fluid secretion, its trafficking and its loss in cystic fibrosis, unlike the SLC26, bicarbonate and cation-chloride transporter confusables.

n03393.head: Plasma membrane lipid asymmetry and integrity
n03393.name: Plasma membrane lipid asymmetry and integrity (flippases and scramblases, membrane repair, mechanical stress response)
n03393.rationale: Members control phospholipid flipping and scrambling and the plasma membrane's response to pressure, stretch, blebbing and damage, separating it from apoptotic-cell clearance and ER lipid-transfer confusables; one mitochondrial housekeeping module fits only loosely.

n00283.head: DNA replication initiation and elongation
n00283.name: DNA replication initiation and elongation (primer synthesis, polymerase switching, Okazaki flap removal)
n00283.rationale: Members are the core steps of replicative DNA synthesis from priming through lagging-strand maturation, unlike the translesion synthesis, repair and cell-cycle confusables.

n02536.head: Lipoyl dehydrogenase complexes and CoA supply
n02536.name: Lipoyl dehydrogenase complexes and CoA supply (pyruvate and 2-oxoglutarate dehydrogenases, protein lipoylation, pantothenate)
n02536.rationale: Members are the lipoylated PDH, OGDH, OADH and glycine cleavage complexes that make acyl-CoAs plus coenzyme A synthesis from pantothenate, while confusables centre on branched-chain catabolism, vitamin B6 or the TCA cycle.

n04421.head: Ubiquitin chain assembly and editing
n04421.name: Ubiquitin chain assembly and editing (linkage-specific chains, deubiquitinases, E1-E2-E3 enzymes)
n04421.rationale: Members build and trim K6/K11/K27/K29/K48/K63 and branched ubiquitin chains via the E1-E2-E3 cascade and DUB families, unlike the proteasome, proteostasis, neddylation and NF-kappaB confusables.

n01271.head: Cell-cycle DNA replication initiation and control
n01271.name: Cell-cycle DNA replication initiation and control (ATR replication-stress checkpoint, E2F targets)
n01271.rationale: Members start and restrain S-phase DNA replication including the ATR replication checkpoint, which separates the theme from the pre-replicative complex, G1/S and unwinding confusables.

n02131.head: Phosphate homeostasis and mineralization
n02131.name: Phosphate homeostasis and mineralization (bone and teeth, ectopic calcification, phosphate transporters)
n02131.rationale: Members link phosphate transport and parathyroid-hormone responses to bone, dentin and enamel mineralization and ectopic calcification disorders, unlike the FGF23-Klotho and type II Na/Pi cotransporter confusables.

n00535.head: Classical cadherin protein-level regulation
n00535.name: Classical cadherin protein-level regulation (E-cadherin trafficking and degradation, cadherin-11 interactions)
n00535.rationale: Members govern E-cadherin processing, trafficking and degradation and cadherin-11 binding at the protein level, unlike confusables on junction assembly, desmosomes or cadherin gene transcription.

n04008.head: Ascorbate metabolism and thyroid hormonogenesis
n04008.name: Ascorbate metabolism and thyroid hormonogenesis (vitamin C transport, hydrogen peroxide, iodide uptake)
n04008.rationale: Ascorbate/vitamin E handling and peroxide-dependent thyroid hormone generation share only a loose redox link, and the pair separates the theme from iron/ROS detoxification and thyroid-receptor signaling confusables.

n01719.head: SUMOylation of nuclear proteins
n01719.name: SUMOylation of nuclear proteins (chromatin regulators, transcription cofactors, RNA-binding proteins)
n01719.rationale: All members are SUMO conjugation of nuclear substrate classes, and chromatin, cofactor and RNA-binding targets distinguish it from confusables on SUMO processing, replication and nuclear-envelope substrates.

n01599.head: Hedgehog ligand maturation and release
n01599.name: Hedgehog ligand maturation and release (autoprocessing, palmitoylation, ERAD of mutants)
n01599.rationale: Members describe Hedgehog precursor self-cleavage, lipidation, quality control and secretion, unlike the general lipidation, Wnt biogenesis and Notch glycosylation confusables.

n03866.head: Gonadotropin control of gonadal function
n03866.name: Gonadotropin control of gonadal function (ovulation and luteinization, testis development, gonadotropin secretion)
n03866.rationale: Members tie LH/FSH secretion to ovarian cycling and Sertoli/Leydig testis development, separating it from oocyte-maturation, activin/AMH and antral-follicle confusables.

n03918.head: Regulation of endocytic uptake
n03918.name: Regulation of endocytic uptake (receptor internalization, caveolae and rafts, pinocytosis)
n03918.rationale: Members control entry of receptors and fluid into the cell via clathrin, caveolar and pinocytic routes, while confusables concern recycling or lysosomal degradation of internalized receptors.

n03068.head: tRNA maturation and aminoacylation
n03068.name: tRNA maturation and aminoacylation (nuclear tRNA processing, selenocysteine, translational fidelity)
n03068.rationale: Members process, modify and charge cytosolic and mitochondrial tRNAs to keep decoding accurate, with nuclear processing and selenocysteine/readthrough distinguishing it from the RNA modification and mitochondrial gene expression confusables.

n02147.head: ER protein biogenesis and export
n02147.name: ER protein biogenesis and export (cotranslational targeting, quality control, COPII/COPI traffic)
n02147.rationale: Members follow secretory proteins from SRP and tail-anchored insertion through ER folding and quality control to COPII export and COPI retrieval, unlike the Golgi/endosome traffic and membrane insertion confusables.

n02893.head: Histone-modifying transcriptional coregulator complexes
n02893.name: Histone-modifying transcriptional coregulator complexes (lysine and arginine methyltransferases, CHD-NuRD remodellers, RUNX1 cofactors)
n02893.rationale: Members are coregulator complexes that methylate histones or remodel chromatin for transcription factors, distinct from the DNA methylation, PRC2 and deacetylase confusables.

n02413.head: Mitochondrial 2-oxoacid catabolism
n02413.name: Mitochondrial 2-oxoacid catabolism (branched-chain amino acids, 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase complexes, lipoyl and biotin cofactors)
n02413.rationale: Members oxidize pyruvate, 2-oxoglutarate, 2-oxoadipate and branched-chain keto acids with their lipoate, biotin and CoA cofactors and the organic acidemias they cause, unlike the beta-oxidation, vitamin B6 and TCA/iron-sulfur confusables.

n00758.head: Ubiquitin-dependent growth factor receptor downregulation
n00758.name: Ubiquitin-dependent growth factor receptor downregulation (EGF receptor, endocytosis, multivesicular body sorting)
n00758.rationale: Members internalize ubiquitinated receptors such as EGFR and MET and sort them to lysosomes, unlike the ESCRT viral budding and MET/PTK6 signaling confusables.

n02360.head: Skeletal muscle development and contraction
n02360.name: Skeletal muscle development and contraction (sarcomere assembly, neuromuscular junction, dystrophin-glycoprotein complex)
n02360.rationale: Members build and run skeletal muscle fibres including sarcomeres, NMJ clustering and the dystrophin complex, unlike the calcineurin/atrophy and cardiac junction confusables.

n03501.head: Axon pathfinding of major tracts
n03501.name: Axon pathfinding of major tracts (commissural midline crossing, corticospinal and optic tracts, monoaminergic axons)
n03501.rationale: Members guide specific long axon tracts and midline crossing, whereas confusables are defined by the signaling pathways (netrin, SLIT-ROBO, ephrin, L1) rather than the tracts.
